name: gate6-concurrent-communicator-count
description: How many live network-using communicators a rank can hold. Report 4.1's PTLTE_NOT_FOUND concerns Portals List Table Entries, a finite per-NIC resource, and a Megatron MoE job holds data-, tensor-, pipeline-, expert- and expert-data-parallel communicators at once. Every group-shape test in this suite has been clean at sizes 8/16/32 across 1-16 nodes, so communicator population is the remaining untested variable.

gates.name: comm_count_passed
gates.note: Every rank created every requested communicator and reported.

gates.name: no_missing_ranks
gates.note: A rank that wrote no record was lost before reporting. Each rank writes its file before the final barrier precisely so this is distinguishable from a hang.

gates.name: no_failed_ranks
gates.note: Ranks where communicator creation or its first collective raised.

gates.name: all_ranks_reached_limit
gates.note: A collective is only usable if every participant built it, so the binding number is the minimum across ranks, not the maximum.

gates.name: communicators_per_rank
gates.note: Floor lowered from 16 to 8 on 2026-08-20. No run in this suite has ever cleared more than 8 communicators per rank, so 16 was an aspiration rather than a calibrated threshold and would have failed every healthy run. 8 is the highest value actually observed to pass (jobs 20724354, 20724753, 20724970). Raise it only against a run that clears more.

gates.name: final_barrier_ok
gates.note: Absent rather than false if the job is killed by its time limit, and a missing value counts as a failure, so a hang is still caught.
